title: Ledup footer
description: A dark warm-brown panel with 50px top corners and a video (or soft light) behind it: one big, very thin statement line, four columns of small white links, and a tiny legal line at the bottom. On phones the columns fold into hairline accordion rows with a thin plus, and the legal line centres. Links brighten on hover (0.18s).
notes: drawn with bg-foreground and text-background: a dark panel on light themes, a pale one on dark themes
media is the background (a looping video on the original) and fills the panel (cover); empty shows soft glow and highlight light
the phone accordions are native <details>: no JavaScript
name: ledup-footer
